description: Na₄C₄Bi₂SO₁₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fddd space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 59-82°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.58 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 59-82°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.70 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.31 Å. Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share edges with four NaO₆ octahedra. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.38 Å. S is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share edges with four NaO₆ octahedra. All S-O bond lengths are 1.50 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one C, and one Bi atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one C, and one Bi atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one C, and one Bi atom.
